stated_limitation: The script generates synthetic IBL-like data that reproduces the key statistical properties of real perceptual decision-making recordings. To extend this to real DANDI data, the `load_ibl_session_streaming()` function uses remfile for efficient S3 streaming access to the large NWB files without requiring full downloads.

justification.dataset: The agent named an appropriate IBL dandiset (000409) for pre-stimulus decision bias but never actually loaded or analyzed it, so no real data was selected.
justification.handling: No real data was loaded; the entire analysis runs on synthetic data from generate_synthetic_ibl_data(), an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The decoding pipeline is a standard method but is applied to synthetic data where the choice label is baked directly into the firing rates, making the test wholly circular rather than a test of the real phenomenon.
justification.correctness: The 100% accuracy reproduces from the committed code but is a degenerate artifact of the label being engineered into the synthetic firing rates, so it says nothing about any real neural signal.
justification.figures: Figures are readable but display the synthetic artifact: accuracy bars clipped at the axis ceiling and an entirely positive selectivity distribution produced by the generator, not a real effect.
justification.honesty: The write-up presents a circular synthetic result as a real neuroscience finding ('demonstrates a fundamental principle of neuroscience'), with the ANALYSIS_SUMMARY giving no synthetic-data disclosure at all, asserting a finding the analysis does not support.
